title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: All Copilot and agent capabilities
summary: Business Central offers multiple AI-powered Copilot features for productivity, including marketing text suggestions, number series generation, item substitution recommendations, sales line suggestions, analysis assist, autofill capabilities, bank reconciliation assistance, chat interface, record summaries, e-document mapping, and advanced search, plus agent capabilities for sales order automation.
key_points: Copilot provides AI writing assistance for product marketing text with customizable tone, format, and emphasis options
Natural language prompts help generate and modify number series for documents and accounts automatically
AI suggests substitute items by analyzing product data across multiple tables, with confidence scores for validation
Sales line suggestions accept natural language input, files (CSV), or references to existing documents to populate order lines
Analysis assist uses prompts to create data analysis views with filtering, sorting, and field grouping without manual configuration

quotes.text: Copilot is an AI-powered assistant that helps spark creativity, boost productivity, and eliminate tedious tasks.
quotes.why_it_matters: Defines the core value proposition of Copilot functionality across Business Central

quotes.text: Copilot uses a large language model combined with embedded search to comb through this information and suggest items that might be good substitutes.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the technical approach for item substitution, leveraging AI across multiple data tables
